title: Architect
description:
Job description:

Job Title: Architect

No. of Vacancies: 1

Company: Rajesh Sharma Interior Designer LLP

Experience: 2\-5 years

Location: AC Market, Kolkata

Salary: Up to ₹25,000 per month (based on experience and qualifications)

About the Company:

Rajesh Sharma Interior Designer LLP is a growing firm specializing in innovative and functional interior and architectural design solutions. With a strong portfolio of residential and commercial projects, we take pride in delivering quality and excellence.

Job Description:

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented Architect to join our dynamic team at our AC Market office. The selected candidate will play a vital role in designing and managing architecture projects, from concept development to execution.

Key Responsibilities:

Create architectural designs, plans, and working drawings.

Coordinate with clients to understand design needs and incorporate feedback.

Work with AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3Dx Max, Photoshop and other design software to develop high\-quality presentations and technical documents.

Collaborate with project managers, site supervisors, engineers, and contractors.

Ensure all work complies with relevant codes, safety standards, and project timelines.

Conduct site visits to monitor progress and ensure design implementation.

Candidate Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Architecture (B.Arch) or equivalent.

2–5 years of architectural experience preferred.

Proficiency in architectural design software (AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, etc.).

Knowledge of building regulations, materials, and construction techniques.

Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

What We Offer:

Salary range of up to ₹25,000 per month.

Opportunities for career growth and project leadership.

A collaborative and professional work environment.

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):  
\*   
Can you commute to Shakespeare Sarani, Kolkata regularly?

* Are you an immediate joiner?
* Are you comfortable with the salary range of ₹20,000–₹25,000?
* Do you have work experience with AutoCAD, 3ds Max, and Photoshop in the architecture or interior design field?

Work Location: In person
